title: Porta John & Hand Washing
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > U.S. SPECIAL OPERATIONS COMMAND (USSOCOM) > MARSOC H92257
description:
Marine Forces Special Operations Command (MARSOC), Camp Lejeune, NC has a requirement for the Porta-john and Hand-Washing Stations. The items being requested are on an all or none, failure to provide the requested equipment will be considered unacceptable. Please review the request for proposals thoroughly as well as 52.212-1 and 52.212-2.
